about: The secreta of the formulary “Nativity of the Lord — Mass during the Day” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Sanctify, O Lord, the gifts offered, by the new birth of Your Only-begotten, and cleanse us from the stains of our sins. Through the same Jesus Christ, our Lord, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God,

a.g: by the new Nativity of Your Only-begotten
from the stains of our sins
this same Jesus Christ, our Lord
who lives and reigns with You
